long_description:
The last Sunday of every month Emily Phillips leads yoga for all levels at Gravity Hills Event Center. Your ticket includes yoga & beverage

About this Event

The last Sunday of every month Emily Phillips teaches an hour yoga class for all levels. Class is 11:45-12:45 pm and is located at Gravity Hills Event Center (formerly Foxhole). After class everyone heads over to Black Dog Brewing Company at Fletcher Place (formerly Hotel Tango) for a delicious beverage of your choice. Your ticket includes both yoga and a beverage. Please share with your friends! Costume is optional :)

Also check out other in Indianapolis, Health & Wellness events in Indianapolis, Workshops in Indianapolis.
